# VideoDB

Curated by Skill Harbor: perception, memory, and actions for video, live streams, and desktop sessions through the VideoDB Python SDK. It covers ingesting files, URLs, YouTube links, and RTSP feeds; building spoken, scene, and keyword indexes with timestamped search and playable evidence clips; timeline editing (subtitles generated, translated, and burned in, text and image overlays, dubbing, background music); server-side transcoding and smart reframing for social aspect ratios; generative media; real-time visual and spoken alerts on live streams; and macOS desktop capture with session summaries. Includes error-handling patterns for the SDK's sharp edges (index already exists, no-results exceptions, reframe timeouts). By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: requires a VideoDB API key (free tier: 50 uploads, no credit card); desktop capture is macOS only. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
